title: Integrate Lumo native work and reconcile the complete current C4 base
body:
## Current native integration source

Current source: [71a4c1e2304b52005950b12490d070c286c45438](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/commit/71a4c1e2304b52005950b12490d070c286c45438), tree `8633c0ac611f2ba9f261cc247a60997634d43dd9`.

This final targeted patch has parent `7d53f29e68269c21d1d5a66bdf3d488f8e886970`. That parent reconciles the complete actual C4 base `f052c2795b765265dbb6f5c27b9e92b557d39a39` with the tested discovery union `a7bb5815009ea4ae9b8842026f4f3761ae99c98b`. The PR targets the integration branch; Main is unchanged. GitHub currently reports this head mergeable; this does not replace the acceptance gates.

Host integration remains [lumo-lernen PR497](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-lernen/pull/497). A fresh host run pinned to **71a4c1e2** and its actual Android roundtrip are still required. The preceding [cf2593 / native 7d53 run 43582160954](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-lernen/actions/runs/43582160954) passed C4 and the real Android host compile, then failed in the Flutter suite before the native 52/Live/Discovery stages. It is not evidence for this later source.

## Final visible integration corrections

**Original Lumo in the Hub.** Review of the actual previous Hub PNGs found an unconditional primitive character with a purple hoodie. It was not a selected profile avatar or failed GLB fallback. The Hub now uses the unchanged shared `lumo_rigged_actor.gd` already used by the learning world: the actual imported `Lumo-Facial-Mobile.glb`, its 65-bone skeleton, nine original clips and two bound body/facial meshes. No character asset, shared adapter or scene file changed.

The camera fits the whole original figure into the existing free Hero area. All eight routes, profile selectors and Back callback remain connected. ReducedMotion and application pause/resume now reach the genuine rig. Both original Hub layouts have real GPU captures and resource/skin identity proof; a node name alone cannot pass. The existing Discovery verifier now requires the actual `hub-original-identity.json`, including original GLB/rig/mesh source, both layouts and separation from Back/profile/portal rectangles. Its PNG roster, 10-probe/38-PNG markers and receipt structure are unchanged.

**Direct Village return to Flutter.** The previous direct Flutter→Village entry forced the child through Bauwelt before returning to the host. The actual embedded HostBridge launch context now selects a visible `‹ Spiele` control, using the existing save, SceneRouter and acknowledged HostBridge return. A failed save blocks return; a refused JNI acknowledgement remains retryable. Native/internal entries keep `‹ Bauwelt`; the direct entry also retains `Zur Bauwelt` in its pause menu. AndroidBack still pauses.

The additive `[VillageHostReady]` JSON is emitted after actual landscape/UI/plot/resident/camera/layout initialization. It reports real scene, model, save path, counts, host context and selected return destination. The separate Android probe must bind it to the launched native PID, original screenshot and actual visible acknowledged return; the marker alone is not a device screenshot result.

The final delta from 7d53 contains exactly eight source/test paths and four provenance files. All assets/scenes and the established acceptance runners remain unchanged. [Exact source hashes, original logs and rationale](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/blob/71a4c1e2304b52005950b12490d070c286c45438/docs/integration/2026-11-14/HUB_ORIGINAL_AND_VILLAGE_RETURN.md).

## Completed targeted verification on the final patch

| Original or strengthened probe | Actual result | Seconds |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Hub routes, real GLB/rig/skin identity, motion and lifecycle | PASS original 8-route marker |0.967|
| VillageHost actual scene/save/ACK and both navigation contexts | PASS original marker |1.168|
| Original rig, headless |PASS 21 checks|0.816|
| Original HostBridge |PASS all 3 original markers|5.791|
| Original VillageScene |PASS 222 checks|5.279|
| Original VillageEconomy |PASS 337 checks|0.365|
| Discovery evidence checker |PASS 11 methods / 57 negative cases|12.634|
| Production Hub renderer |PASS 2 original PNGs|15.176|
| Original Discovery image/identity replay |PASS 38 PNGs|1.159|

The previous Hub fails the new real identity probe (exit 1); the missing direct Village return was also reproduced before its correction. The final runtime logs have no script/parse/engine error, assertion or object/resource-leak marker. The initial camera framing failure was corrected without relaxing containment.

Root and Android QA independently viewed the new original figure from the same final production Hub blob. Landscape shows all eight routes completely. Portrait preserves the existing scroll area: six complete cards and the final two continuing below. No simultaneous 8/8 portrait claim is made.

Only the affected two Hub images were rerendered. The 38-image replay combines those two with the 36 unchanged original Learning/Wonder images. It is explicitly a compatibility replay, not 38 fresh renders. The local materialized source has no Git HEAD; its 1391-file base inventory and changed files are checked against actual Git blobs. The published commit/tree are real GitData objects. [Final local verification record](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/blob/71a4c1e2304b52005950b12490d070c286c45438/docs/integration/2026-11-14/hub-original-verification.json).

## Durable original image evidence

**Final Original-Lumo Hub evidence** is on separate evidence-only commit [02192998d8b2ee0e61cad12b52dd1cc3c746c3c5](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/commit/02192998d8b2ee0e61cad12b52dd1cc3c746c3c5), whose parent is the exact 71a4 runtime source:

- [Two unedited actual Hub PNGs, GLB/rig/framing JSON and original logs](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/blob/02192998d8b2ee0e61cad12b52dd1cc3c746c3c5/docs/evidence/hub-original-20261114/hub-original-rendered-evidence.tar.gz).
- Archive SHA256 `db025f01068d0db82379a774246df20fb6cbdd60c58dd5f4a0e0325e7271921b`, 3,711,954 bytes.
- Portrait 1080×1920 SHA256 `c479d48648cf933e9ce53f65d8d324ae4cc0dce6de18eaa67dd812848a157b46`.
- Landscape 2400×1080 SHA256 `aa22c4818959435cbb4ed24c9470a76be55581e3fd65cd560eb52c0c145f34a9`.

The archive was freshly extracted; both original hashes/dimensions and actual Hub identity were verified again.

**Earlier full 38-image discovery evidence** remains on [e4fa9bc338f1dee29ec8706c7ddf624fddd35c22](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/commit/e4fa9bc338f1dee29ec8706c7ddf624fddd35c22) for its original source scope:

- [25 original learning images](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/blob/e4fa9bc338f1dee29ec8706c7ddf624fddd35c22/docs/evidence/discovery-union-20261114/discovery-learning-25-originals.tar.gz), SHA256 `19730b9f9c0db4a3a11ad2469432a3506025c6fc99f11e789a452b92a6de0054`.
- [Earlier 2 hub and 11 Wonder originals](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/blob/e4fa9bc338f1dee29ec8706c7ddf624fddd35c22/docs/evidence/discovery-union-20261114/discovery-hub-wonder-13-originals.tar.gz), SHA256 `0ceaddf363924e16c0839905a4cac0fd76e3ac231285b825c90e4ca5981d05d6`.

These evidence branches do not replace the runtime pin.

## Preserved bounded producer union and actual f052 reconciliation

The existing union selected exactly 23 original producer blobs from [PR174](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/pull/174), [PR175](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/pull/175), [PR176](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/pull/176) and [PR178](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/pull/178): task-linked success feedback, eight real Hub routes, explicit Village host boot and reactive flowers in the established production learning scene. Earlier C4 acknowledged-return recovery, Treasure wisps, title/cutout fixes, ambience and village behavior remain included. [Original source/provenance manifest](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/blob/7d53f29e68269c21d1d5a66bdf3d488f8e886970/docs/integration/2026-11-14/discovery-source-manifest.json).

The 20-path f052 base delta had nine already identical files, ten additive historical evidence files and one differing Wisp test. The reconciliation retained exact blob `67927a6f2147658d13e60cacdbbd24bf717a0c1d`: all 14 original checks plus four actual MultiMesh renderer checks. The 7d53 reconciliation itself changed no game runtime; its only tooling change raised the existing 25-image learning deadline to 900 s after a successful 580.766 s run, matching the 52-mode runner. The later 71a4 runtime changes are explicitly described above. [Exact f052 evidence](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/blob/7d53f29e68269c21d1d5a66bdf3d488f8e886970/docs/integration/2026-11-14/native-base-f052-reconciliation.json).

The earlier union passed 5347 Learning, 1811 Sharing, 183 Studio, 100/108 Wonder headless/renderer and 136 Wonder capture checks, plus the original 25 Learning and 11 Wonder PNGs. Their original durations, logs and source limitations remain in [the union verification report](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/blob/7d53f29e68269c21d1d5a66bdf3d488f8e886970/docs/integration/2026-11-14/DISCOVERY_FINAL_VERIFICATION.md).

## Mandatory final acceptance

The exact-source host pipeline retains the 52-mode suite, 17 Studio rasters/movie/sidecar requirements, 47 original helper/runner tests, C4 return 21 and Wisp 18 renderer checks. Live 9/seven-PNG is followed by mandatory Discovery 10/38 with independent logs and exact commit/tree binding. The final checker additionally requires the actual original Hub identity.

The final host/native run, API 35 Android tour including the direct Village roundtrip, preserved 2017→2020 update tour, data/learning preservation and signed APK gates remain mandatory. No final APK release or physical Android FPS acceptance is claimed by the local software-renderer evidence.
